title: The Rain, 2026
logline: The twenty-ninth January. The sill, four jars, rain — and the wall of boxes behind the table now reaching thirty-six, their numbers in the lamp's light. The last Rain but one.

panels.composition: The garage in January rain from the doorway: the window with four jars, the lamp on, and along the wall the boxes numbered to thirty-six stacked three high, the pup in the bed beneath the table.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage studio in January rain seen from its doorway with four jars on a rainy sill, a lit lamp, and a wall of numbered cardboard boxes stacked three high, a small three-legged dog in a bed beneath the table, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Thirty-six boxes. The last Rain but one.
